summary.files_scanned_rule: all tracked text blobs under --path at --rev, no size skip
summary.files_skipped_rule: tracked blobs excluded because they contain NUL; every skip needs review
summary.finding_count_rule: explicitly zoned timestamp occurrences strictly later than their line's introducing committer-time
summary.unexempted_finding_count_rule: future_dated occurrences not matched by --allow FILE:LINE
